# Dilkusha Biryani

> Pure veg namkeen, gajak, cakes, cookies and bakery items, freshly prepared in Lucknow (Uttar Pradesh, India) and delivered across the city, usually in about 45 minutes for nearby areas. Tagline: "Swaad Bhi, Sehat Bhi".

Customers browse products by category, add them to a cart and pay online at checkout. Prices are in Indian rupees (INR). Custom cakes, gift hampers and bulk orders are available on request.
